metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic studio still life showing a tall, slender glass vase filled with dark sand. The entire vase is leaning sharply at a forty-five-degree angle to the right, yet its small circular base remains completely flat and stationary on a level tabletop without tipping. Soft directional lighting, high detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The leaning vase shifts its center of mass well outside the narrow base footprint, making it physically impossible to remain stationary without falling.
